# GSAP

Vendored GSAP **3.13.0** for section transitions, project filtering and image-dialog animation.

- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/gsap.min.js
- Documentation: https://gsap.com/docs/v3/
- License: https://gsap.com/standard-license/

The original license header is preserved in `gsap.min.js`. Keeping the library local allows animations to work when opening `index.html` directly, without a CDN connection. Navigation and image previews also work if GSAP fails to load. Animations respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
